about: Template-slot labels that turn Loghub's OpenSSH sample (2,000 real sshd lines, Loghub commit dd61d09) into a gold standard. One entry per template: a label for each <*> slot in order (HOST, USER or null), plus account names that appear literally in the template text. Gold rule: a HOST slot whose value is a valid IP address is IP_ADDRESS; a HOST slot holding a hostname (public reverse-DNS names of remote hosts) is not gold; every USER slot value and every literal account name is USERNAME; ports, uids, counts and other slots are not gold.
drafted_by: AI assistant (Claude), from the template text only
